svg.title: P6 Pentium II block diagram
svg.desc: Bus interface with half-speed L2, 16KB L1 caches, BTB, 4-1-1 decoders and microcode ROM feeding a register alias table, reservation station and reorder buffer, dispatching to five execution ports.

g.text: x86 to micro-ops, up to 3 per cycle
Renames 8 arch registers onto ROB entries
